text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to head to the academy track that
evening to speak to
McQueen. Along the
way...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! I've been meaning to
speak with you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have news about the grace period before
Team Sirius's dissolution!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you'll be happy to hear this. You
have until the end of this
term, so the end
of June.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, the academy recognizes
that the students have races
to focus on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They decided to allow you both ample
time to train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm relieved. That means we can forget
about our recruitment issues
for now!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all,
I'm only the messenger! But I'm
glad too. Good luck at the
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The track is empty at this time of night.
Most Umamusume are already
in bed
now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that's not stopping McQueen. How
many nights has it been now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it's plain to see that the
overwork has taken a toll on her
form.
Both her upper and lower balance are off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I would hate to see all of this
ineffective
training lead to an injury just
before the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Mmph, ah... Ahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that very moment, McQueen wavers
and falls to the ground amidst
a cloud of
dirt.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Where am I... Oh. Trainer? Why are you—

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We're in the infirmary.
You should lie back
down. Seems you have a
fever.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We're in the infirmary.
You should lie back
down. Seems you have a
fever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A fever? Oh... I must have been more
fatigued than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, I often used to break
out into fevers after
running around in my
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So it would seem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, did you know this whole time?!
A-about my going out at
night?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I had planned to confront you
about it tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see...
You always are sharp when it comes
to these sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and say it, then. No more
private training, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Considering what I've brought upon
myself, I have no room to argue.
You have
my word.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Then you're officially banned from
training
at night... but in
exchange, let me be here
for you. Open up to me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Then you're officially banned from
training
at night... but in
exchange, let me be here
for you. Open up to me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Let me help you realize your dream of
winning the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Let me help you realize your dream of
winning the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How did you... Ah! Did you hear that from
Ryan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So that's what Ryan's little secret was all about! Meddling as ever, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But are you sure? If you're serious about
helping me, you need to be
prepared to
handle the responsibility of training a
Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready for that? To... well... to
become one of heart and mind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
no hesitation at all. That part of you
hasn't changed at all from
your assistant
trainer days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Always putting us first...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then I shall not hold anything
back any longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll be as selfish as it takes to make my
dreams of victory at the Tenno
Sho come
true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am going to win!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do this together!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do this together!
